comment: Very kind man who obviously cares about what he teaches. Unfortunately, I found the content of FYS Lost in Translation very boring. He is a great teacher, but I would not recommend that class

Absolutly an amazing teacher. The assignements are a lot of fun and really straight forward. There are weekly quizzes, but they are definitely easier the higher level class you go. Class topics are relevant, and he keeps a very manageable pace. He is super flexible and a great prof in the German department.

Prof. Beals is sweet and a veryyy lenient grader. Only had 3 papers (all 3 also had revised versions) and he gave great feedback. The subject material was pretty boring so class discussions could get long, but if you do the homework and come up with some talking points in class it will make the class a lot less painful. Would recommend for FYS

Lectures could be a little boring if not interested in the topic, but that was the hardest part of the course. there was a lot of reading but was not tested on material. assignments were short. he gave a ton of feedback on papers and allowed revisions which were graded easy

Dr. Beals is a wonderful professor. I had his FYS class called Lost in translation. He is very relaxed and understanding of students and their commitments. Lots of in-class and online discussion and both of them play a large role in grades. Only 3 papers for the entire class. Lots of readings that can range from 40-70 for each class.
